title: Telemetry Leak of Sensitive PII
pattern: Directly formatting raw, unredacted user inputs, passwords, security tokens, or personal identifiers (PII) into telemetry or logging buffers.
why_bad: Renders cleartext logging stores highly attractive targets for attackers, violating security constraints and user trust [83, 179].
detection: Passing variables matching patterns of passwords, tokens, or personal profiles into log format strings.
fix: Sanitize or explicitly redact any sensitive parameters before passing them to the logging macro.
